capabilities: trim trailing spaces, tabs, and lines
trim leading spaces, tabs, and lines
collapse runs of multiple spaces, tabs, or blank lines
trim on manual save or automatically after a delay
preserve whitespace inside code blocks and indented lists
extras: Ownership transferred from the original author Zack (@zlovatt) in October 2026; README lists a known bug where full-document trimming does not reset the cursor position correctly.
problem: Obsidian documents accumulate unnecessary blank characters that code editors normally strip out, and there is no built-in way to remove them.
summary: Whitespace cleanup tool that trims trailing, leading, and repeated spaces, tabs, and blank lines from documents or selections.
